limitations: Fixed-atom 1D estimate covering O-H stretch and the 1D O...O transfer coordinate only, not stretch-bend coupling or other collective anharmonicity. A scan whose endpoint slope points inward is cut at its outermost fitted maximum (flag truncated_at_endpoint); any well beyond the scanned range is not modelled.

selection_rule: Largest multiplicity-weighted mean of per-H max absolute P16-P128 residuals among mp-23807, mp-625054, JVASP-54682, JVASP-92228; mp-625152 excluded. All four values are required; ties follow the listed order.
a4b_bound_rule: Decision 19 rule 3: r_f(P)=Delta_f(P)-Delta_f(128); t_f=Delta_f(128)-Delta_f(inf). A_i(P)=sum_h (m_h/N_H) * max_(q,mu) [max_f abs(r_f(P)) + (max_f r_f(P)-min_f r_f(P)) + max_f abs(t_f)], f in {degree_10, degree_8, spline (not-a-knot)}. Directions and mass models are alternatives, never summed; units meV/H.
a4b_plateau_sensitivity_rule: Sensitivity only, never sets eligibility or the primary A4b bound. b_poly(P)=abs(r_10(P))+max(0.01, abs(r_11(P)-r_10(P)), abs(r_12(P)-r_10(P))); sum_h (m_h/N_H) * max_(q,mu) b_poly(P), in meV/H. Any failed degree makes the sensitivity unavailable, not the primary bound.
